run_online_dpo_training: run online DPO training with a causal language model and reward model on a dataset
run_online_dpo_with_lora: run online DPO training with LoRA PEFT configuration for parameter-efficient fine-tuning
build_online_dpo_trainer: build an OnlineDPOTrainer with model, reward model, datasets, tokenizer, and PEFT config
run_online_dpo_with_quantization: run online DPO training with 4-bit or 8-bit quantization on the language model
run_online_dpo_with_logging: run online DPO training with LogCompletionsCallback for logging generated completions during evaluation
